channel.title: VENI Blog — real estate in Greece, Bulgaria and Europe
channel.description: Property market news, laws, prices and life in Greece and Bulgaria. Every day, by Venera Khassanova.

item.title: A 15% tax for non-EU buyers: what is changing in Greece and why 2027 matters
item.description: Greece plans to raise the tax on buying a home fivefold for citizens of non-EU countries. Here is who it affects, when it starts and what to do if you are looking at a house by the sea.

item.title: Burgas has overtaken Sofia in house price growth. Buy now or wait?
item.description: Housing in Bulgaria got almost 15% more expensive in a year, and Burgas rose fastest of all. Here is what is happening after the switch to the euro, and what it means if you are thinking about a flat by the sea.
